description: This file defines a React component ContentTableView that renders a data table displaying various items such as files and notes, with functionalities like sorting, context menus, and linking. It includes child components for context menus, item name display, and linked items management, utilizing hooks and external controllers for application logic.

methods.name: ContextMenuCell
methods.description: Renders a button that toggles a context menu with options for files or notes based on the selected items.

methods.name: ItemLinksCell
methods.description: Displays a button that opens a popover panel showing linked items related to the given item.

methods.name: ItemNameCell
methods.description: Displays the item's icon, title, backup status, and protection status.

methods.name: AttachedToCell
methods.description: Shows linked items attached to the current item, with the ability to unlink.

methods.name: ContentTableView
methods.description: Main React component that renders a table of items with sorting, context menus, and actions.
